== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Leia (Japanese ESB Two-Player)|Leia]] from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/starwarscollector-1/imagegallery/127305 StarWarsCollector_#1's PSA gallery], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/167676918/xMOn-sEmJ0W1p4m142bU3w.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 99569924.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 623, 1290, 2203)</code>. Source SHA-256 <code>9cbbec9f82b1db4f4cbe1f95902accb8dee39d00bd9b73dcc046b82baca038b9</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
